main_text.p: feu e vafe afcendentem ad marginemuf- que, recifuram in vas ipfum,atque quafi ponderofiorem, retrafturam unalecum aquam exteriorem, ipfam marginem praerergreffam, fi tantum aquae e vafe exhauriatur, ut ejus fuperficies apice lingulae ultra marginem propendentis inferior exiftat. Non eadem aquae in tali lingula ratio, quae in tubo retorto, in quem aer le nequeat infinuare: In tubi brachio,feu crure,ultra marginem pro- pendente,fufpenditur aqua atque haeret immobilis in aequilibro quafi,ubi extre- mitas ejus in eadem linea horizontali confiftit cum fuperficie aquein vafe con- trentae;fi ultra lineam horizontalem pro- pendeat aqua, profluit continue atque attrahit aquam e vafe in tubum, donec aequilibrium oboriatur; fi poft aequili- brium factum, nonnihil aquae e vafe exhauriatur, vel vafis aut tubi inclina- tio aliqua fiat, ut extremitas aquae, pro- pendentis in tubo ultra marginem va- fis, lineam horizontalem cum fuperficie

page.notes: Page number and running head are as read from the scan; the page number "791" is partly uncertain (printed as 79[?]1 or 191). Words at the line ends marked "fi", "aequili-", and "ultra" are as printed. Some words in the top lines are uncertain: "marginem" and "aquae" may be misread. The final lines are partly faint.
